# V8 construction and sources

Geometry: original, photo-informed interpretations, not measured park CAD or scanned interiors. Scene dimensions and decorative arrangements remain estimates. Disney reference photography was used only for research and is not included in the website.

## Rides

Fantasia Carousel: original continuous horse/wing shapes, saddles, bridles, poles, mirrored drum, curtains, columns and fencing; independent rotation and galloping clips. Rex RC Racer: original rails, trusses, foundations, station and RC car with restraints/wheels. Woody: original pony and wagon with wheels, wood boards, leaf springs and lap bars; six animated copies at runtime. Jet Packs and Slinky mechanisms are original runtime geometry; the outdoor mine train alignment follows OSM with estimated elevations.

References:
- https://www.shanghaidisneyresort.com/zh-cn/experience/attraction/fantasia-carousel
- https://www.shanghaidisneyresort.com/zh-cn/experience/attraction/rexs-rc-racer
- https://www.shanghaidisneyresort.com/zh-cn/experience/attraction/woodys-round-up

- https://disneyparksblog.com/disney-experiences/toy-story-at-disney-parks-and-more/

Original ride geometry and procedural textures are supplied under CC0 by their authoring agent for this project. This does not license Disney names, characters or trademarks.

## Furniture and ground

Original 3.5 m lamp, 2.2 m bench, 1.2 m sandstone edging. General construction references: Valmont Heritage lighting; Paris municipal history of Davioud street furniture. These are inspired original models, not exact Shanghai Disneyland furniture measurements.

CC0 PBR textures:
- Rectangular Paving, Dimitrios Savva: https://polyhaven.com/a/rectangular_paving (2 m repeat, 2K)
- Oak Veneer 02, Jenelle van Heerden: https://polyhaven.com/a/oak_veneer_02
- Green Metal Rust: https://polyhaven.com/a/green_metal_rust
- Old Sandstone 02, Dimitrios Savva: https://polyhaven.com/a/old_sandstone_02
- Grass001, Lennart Demes: https://ambientcg.com/a/Grass001 (1.4 m repeat, 1K; official page describes procedural creation)
- Licenses: https://polyhaven.com/license and https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/

## Castle and ordinary buildings

Original castle retained with added window leadwork, gilded roof ornaments, ridge metalwork, carved limestone details and arch ribs. Window/store interiors are illustrative original geometry, not photographed or measured rooms. Modern buildings use rectangular recessed windows with desks, chairs and curtains. Local roughness, normal maps and small variation are used to separate plaster, metal, stone, wood and leaves.

The unnamed OSM building footprint 754485727 intersects the estimated Rex track/station assembly. Its generic solid building is suppressed in favor of the authored ride assembly to avoid visible intersections. This is an artistic reconciliation, not a verified classification of that footprint. Other adjoining mapped buildings are retained.
